limits: Both branches run the same current physical solver. The sole policy difference is whether the existing finite landing estimate may interrupt the original schedule.
A return to ground sacrifices the remaining requested stages; cancelled is deliberate and is not counted as original-task completion.
100/150/200/350 bar were the exploratory comparison; 125/275 bar are additional preselected pressure checks, not real-vehicle validation.

The reserve forecast is one-dimensional and only used inside its calm, nearly level validity envelope. The 25% predicted remaining fraction is an explicit conservative policy margin, not an actuator increase or certified safe reserve.
Touchdown speed is sampled from successive 120 Hz control states; contact may begin inside a refined step. This is not a native-video or crash-safety certificate.
The separate finite 100 bar disturbance-landing research task retains its existing failed outcome; its task protocol is not shortened or replaced.
